summary: Unity Global Trading Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company registered in Selangor on June 15, 2018, with registration number SYN-000029 and a share capital of 250,000, operating in the retail industry with a nature of business focused on the retail of textiles and baju kurung. The company is managed by five directors—Director 1 (Managing Director), Director 2 (Independent Director), Director 3, Director 4, and Director 5 (Executive Director)—who also hold share percentages of 12.21%, 8.32%, 58.25%, and 21.22% respectively among individual shareholders. Audited financial statements from Audit Firm 8 with unqualified opinions for the financial years ending in 2022, 2023, and 2024 show revenues growing from 5,130,131 to 5,352,856, and net profits after tax recording 113,910, 97,951, and 96,805 respectively, alongside total assets increasing from 7,723,803 in 2022 to 8,059,132 by 2024 with no recorded litigation cases.

Jaya Prima Travel Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-000067) is an active private limited company incorporated in Kuala Lumpur on April 1, 1995, operating in the hospitality industry as a travel agency for umrah and inbound tourism with a share capital of 2,500,000. Led by four directors—including Managing Director Director 1, Independent Director Director 3, and Directors 2 and 4—the company is owned by shareholders Director 1 (47.38%), Director 2 (34.78%), and Director 4 (17.84%). Financial records audited by Audit Firm 7 with unqualified opinions across fiscal years 2022, 2023, and 2024 indicate declining revenues from 49,467,702 in 2022 down to 43,292,441 in 2024, alongside continuous net losses after tax worsening from 4,244,828 in 2022 to 7,515,861 in 2024, and total assets decreasing from 71,592,364 to 62,655,189 over the same three-year period.

Indah Prima Medical Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company incorporated on April 30, 1993, operating in the healthcare industry within the state of Kelantan with a share capital of 500,000 and focusing on community pharmacy and health supplements. The company is managed by five directors—who also serve as its individual shareholders owning various percentages of the company, led by Director 4 holding 75.61%—and has undergone audits by Audit Firm 5 resulting in unqualified opinions for the financial years ending in 2022, 2023, and 2024, during which it recorded revenues of 5,529,168, 5,340,763, and 4,835,417 respectively, alongside zero active litigation cases.

Teguh Kirana Freight Sdn. Bhd. (SYN-000165) is an active private limited company incorporated in Pulau Pinang on September 6, 1992, with a share capital of 2,500,000 and a nature of business focused on last-mile parcel delivery across Kuching. The company is led by five directors, with Director 5 holding a 98.34% shareholder stake and Director 4 holding 1.66%. Over the financial years ending in 2022, 2023, and 2024, the company recorded revenues of 10,874,080, 15,043,308, and 21,522,626 respectively, all audited by Audit Firm 5 with unqualified opinions. Additionally, the company was recently involved as a plaintiff in a settled debt recovery case filed in the Sessions Court of Pulau Pinang on September 26, 2024, involving a claim amount of 169,800.0.

Teguh Bestari Learning Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company in the education sector incorporated in Selangor on December 7, 1991, with a share capital of 2,500,000, and its nature of business is operating private kindergartens and nurseries (tadika swasta dan taska) in Johor Bahru. The company is managed by two directors—Director 1 (Managing Director, holding 51.02% shares) and Director 2 (holding 48.98% shares)—and has no recorded litigation cases. Across the 2022, 2023, and 2024 financial years, all audited by Audit Firm 3 which issued an unqualified opinion in 2022 and 2024 alongside a disclaimer of opinion in 2023, the company grew its revenue from 2,976,052 to 5,606,840, increased its profit after tax from 138,435 to 386,389, and expanded its total assets from 3,366,741 to 6,342,892.

Global Everbright Store Sdn. Bhd. (registration number SYN-000267) is an active private limited company incorporated on October 28, 1990, located in Kuala Lumpur, with a share capital of 500,000 and a former name of Sinar Industries Sdn. Bhd. engaged in the retail of textiles and baju kurung. The company is managed by three directors—Director 1 (Managing Director), Director 2 (Executive Director), and Director 3 (Independent Director)—with Director 1 holding 89.67% and Director 2 holding 10.33% of the shares. Over the financial years 2022 to 2024, the company's revenue grew from 17,700,737 to 19,374,478, with net profits after tax recorded at 519,141 in 2022, 406,159 in 2023, and 473,200 in 2024, all audited by Audit Firm 2 with unqualified opinions. Additionally, the company has been involved in five litigation cases as a plaintiff concerning breach of contract and debt recovery, out of which two are settled, one is pending, one is dismissed, and one is withdrawn.

Delima Pacific Academy Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company incorporated in Kuala Lumpur on June 5, 1991, with a share capital of 250,000, operating in the education industry by providing professional training courses in accounting and finance. The company is led by Managing Director Director 1, who holds a 57.42% share, and Executive Director Director 2, who owns the remaining 42.58% share. Over the financial years 2022 to 2024, the company's revenue grew from 25,095,450 to 27,546,638, with profits after tax recorded at 1,392,816 in 2022, 2,026,448 in 2023, and 1,865,751 in 2024, all backed by unqualified audit opinions from Audit Firm 4 and maintaining zero recorded litigation cases.

Cahaya Seri Catering Sdn. Bhd. (Registration Number SYN-000286) is an active private limited company incorporated in Sabah on November 20, 2017, with a share capital of 500,000, operating in the Food and Beverage industry with the nature of business being the wholesale distribution of frozen food to restaurants. The company is led by Managing Director Director 1, Executive Director Director 2, and Independent Director Director 3, with Director 1 holding a 98.86% share and Director 2 holding 1.14%. Financial records show growth from the 2022 financial year—reporting revenues of 4,205,420 and a profit after tax of 173,231—to the 2024 financial year, where revenues reached 4,419,464 and profit after tax was 178,923, both audited by Audit Firm 8 with unqualified opinions. Additionally, the company has been involved in six litigation cases as a defendant in Sabah courts, including a pending winding-up petition, a debt recovery case with judgment entered, settled construction and employment claims, a settled/pending tenancy dispute, and a dismissed tenancy dispute.

Global Pacific Perunding Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company incorporated in Perak on January 15, 2014, with a share capital of 500,000 and a registration number of SYN-000302. Operating within the professional services industry, the company's nature of business is management consulting for SMEs. It is managed by three directors—Director 1 (Managing Director, appointed April 15, 2021), Director 2 (Director, appointed May 1, 2024), and Director 3 (Executive Director, appointed March 25, 2018)—who also serve as the company's shareholders, holding 11.54%, 58.7%, and 29.76% of the shares, respectively.

Gemilang Harmoni Enterprise Sdn. Bhd. is an active private limited company registered under the number SYN-000333 on October 21, 1997, in Sarawak, operating in the retail industry with a share capital of 5,000,000 and a former name of Unity Industries Sdn. Bhd. changed on September 3, 2025. The company specializes in the retail of textiles and baju kurung, and its leadership and ownership consist of three individuals: Director 1, who serves as Managing Director and holds a 25.02% share; Director 2, who is a director holding a 45.57% share; and Director 3, who is also a director holding a 29.41% share.
